query: UPDATE executions e SET status='expired',error='Approval expired or caller was revoked',finished_at=now() WHERE e.status='paused' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM paused_runs p WHERE p.execution_id=e.id AND p.expires_at>now()) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens a JOIN endpoints ep ON ep.id=a.workspace_id WHERE a.id=e.token_id AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND (a.expires_at IS NULL OR a.expires_at>now()) AND (a.oauth_grant IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oauth_grants g WHERE g.id=a.oauth_grant AND g.endpoint_id=ep.id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.expires_at>now())))) RETURNING e.id
